# Integration Verification — Init Status
exec akb --version
stdout 'akb (dev|0\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'

exec akb init test-kb
stdout 'Initialized KB "test-kb"'
stdout 'and set as default'

cd test-kb

exists kb
exists raw
exists .akb
exists .akb/templates

exists kb/index.md
exists kb/log.md
exists raw/files.log

exists .akb/.akb.yaml

exists .akb/templates/note.yaml
exists .akb/templates/adr.yaml

exists .akb/search.db

exists .akb/.gitignore
exists .gitignore

grep 'search\.db' .akb/.gitignore
grep '\.akb\.bak' .gitignore

exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: init test-kb'

exec akb status
stdout 'Name: test-kb'
stdout 'Pages: 0'
stdout 'Git: clean'
